fields.label: City
fields.note: Free-text city input of the JazzHR advanced-search form; the same form also has a separate s_state <select> (US/Canada state or province, '0' = Any state or province) which is not mapped to a schema key.

fields.label: Department
fields.note: Free-text department input (name=s_department); no fixed option list is published.

notes: HackerEarth's careers page embeds the JazzHR board in iframe#jazzhr-job-frame (https://hackerearth.applytojob.com/apply/jobs/). The board exposes a real GET search form: action=/apply/jobs with hidden form_id=advanced_search_jobs plus q (simple search), s_title, s_city, s_state, s_keywords, s_type, s_department. All filtering is server-side on that GET request; no sort control is published.
evidence: https://hackerearth.applytojob.com/apply/jobs/ <form id='form_advanced_search_jobs' action='/apply/jobs' method='GET'> inputs: form_id=advanced_search_jobs, s_title, s_city, s_state, s_keywords, s_type, s_department; <form id='form_search_jobs'> input name='q'
